'''Magical Pokémon Journey: Fun at the Beach''' is the fourth monthly issue released by [[VIZ Media]] of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga created by [[Yumi Tsukirino]]. It contains the first three bonus chapters of the manga. The chapters originally released in this book were later rereleased as part of {{Vol|Magical Pokémon Journey|1}}. As a bonus, it contained a fold-out color poster which was not part of the regular volume.
==Blurb==
'''''THE BRINY DEEP'''''

''3 stories this issue! Hazel goes to the beach with Almondo, and with the help of a Horsea, learns the wonders of the underwater Pokémon world.'' 

''Then, frightening ghost Pokémon await Hazel in the Tunnel of Horrors-but for Hazel, cuteness is in the eye of the beholder!''

''Finally, Jigglypuff causes trouble at a Pokémon birthday party.''
